en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hillside covered in terraced vineyards with scattered trees and small paths. At the foot of the hill stand several early‑20th‑century villa-style houses with gardens and fences. On the hilltop to the right there is a larger building or small castle-like structure flying a flag. The caption at the bottom left, printed in red, identifies the location as Kötzschenbroda–Niederlößnitz, and a publisher line appears beneath it.
